sentences.text: By day, a vessel engaged in fishing shows two cones with their apexes together, one above the other.
A vessel fishing with outlying gear extending more than one hundred fifty meters also shows a cone, apex upward, in the direction of the gear.
When a fishing vessel is not engaged in fishing, she shows only the normal lights or shapes for a vessel of her length.
So a shrimp boat steaming home at night with her nets stowed shows ordinary power-driven lights, and has none of the privileges of a fishing vessel.
